title: Baseball Through the Numbers
text:
Using Lahman data, this site tracks Major League home runs across seasons. Comparing home runs per team-game puts shortened seasons on fairer footing and shows that fewer games do not explain every dip in the rate.
Barry Bonds leads the career list with 762 home runs, followed by Hank Aaron and Babe Ruth. Use the Home runs and Sluggers pages in the navbar to explore season trends, the career leaders, and Bonds’s year-by-year totals.
